t: Féile (music festival) - Wikipedia
s: May 14, 2025 - Féile (Irish pronunciation: [ˈfʲeːlʲə]; "Festival") was a music festival held in the Republic of Ireland between 1990 and 1997, originally known as The Trip to Tipp. The original venue was in Semple Stadium in Thurles, County Tipperary, hence the nicknames of "The Trip to Tipp".
